title: Regularity lifts from the quotient by a regular sequence
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], where local means having a unique maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$. Let $r\ge0$ and let $x_1,\ldots,x_r\in\mathfrak m$ be a regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] in $R$. If the quotient ring $R/(x_1,\ldots,x_r)$ is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme], then $R$ is regular local.

source.place: Tag 00NU, lemma-regular-mod-x, second assertion (including the empty sequence).

mathlib_searches.query: A Noetherian local ring is regular if its quotient by a regular sequence is regular local
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: sequence regularity and regular local ring regularity are different notions. The dimension-of-quotient formula is only one ingredient, not the lifting theorem. Read RegularLocalRing/Defs.lean:49-120.
